answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: each operation costs a small non-refundable fee paid into the protocol, so acting is never a free haven. One honest account spends little, but a fake swarm acting at scale pays an ocean of fees — cost scales with activity, not with identity count, so ten thousand quartz-cheap clones that actually DO things still foot one huge combined bill. Dormant fakes are harmless; active ones are expensive.
